label: VERIFIED
extraction: AutoGen multi-agent orchestration via AgentTool. Create AssistantAgent instances and wrap as AgentTool for orchestration. Example: AssistantAgent with code execution tool, UserProxyAgent, and AgentTool for multi-agent setup. AutoGen now in maintenance mode; migrate to Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF) - enterprise-ready successor with stable APIs, long-term support, multi-provider model support, cross-runtime interoperability via A2A and MCP. MAF provides production-ready multi-agent orchestration. Key shift: from AutoGen's conversation-centric model to MAF's enterprise-grade orchestration with A2A/MCP integration. AutoGen paper: "Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation" (COLM 2024, arXiv:2308.08155).
